jobs.title: VP of Finance
jobs.description:
About Snaplii

Snaplii is a profitable, fast-growing fintech company building the next generation of payments and AI-powered financial solutions across North America.
Our traction:
400K+ users and approximately CAD $200M (US$150M) in annual payment volume.
3x year-over-year company growth, with profitable operations.
500+ brand partners, including Walmart and Uber.
AI-powered payments live on Muse, with 2,000+ AI agents connected to Snaplii's payment infrastructure.

AI generates demand. Snaplii executes the payment.
We are looking for a hands-on VP of Finance who can own the company's financial operations end to end, build and lead a strong finance team, and support our next stage of growth and fundraising.
Key Responsibilities

Accounting & Financial Controls

Own accounting, financial reporting, audits, tax compliance, and internal controls.
Ensure accurate and timely financial statements and month-end closing.
Build scalable financial processes and systems.

P&L & Financial Performance

Own company-wide P&L, budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning.
Drive profitability, unit economics, and cost optimization.
Partner with business leaders to improve financial performance.

Treasury, Banking & Payment Operations

Own cash flow, liquidity, treasury management, and capital allocation.
Build and manage strategic relationships with banks, financial institutions, and payment partners.
Lead banking negotiations, account structures, funding arrangements, and banking infrastructure improvements.
Oversee payment flows, settlements, reconciliation, and fund movements.
Identify and resolve transaction discrepancies, liquidity risks, and operational issues.

Digital Transformation & Financial Systems

Lead digital transformation across finance, treasury, and payment operations.
Drive automation of accounting, reconciliation, reporting, and financial workflows.
Implement and optimize ERP, treasury management, and financial reporting systems.
Partner with engineering and product teams to improve financial infrastructure, data accuracy, and operational efficiency.
Leverage AI and technology to build scalable, automated financial operations.

Fundraising & Investor Relations

Lead financial preparation and execution for fundraising with top-tier VC firms.
Own financial models, investor materials, due diligence, and data rooms.
Work directly with the CEO on fundraising strategy, investor relationships, and board reporting.

Team Building & Leadership

Build, manage, and develop a high-performing finance team.
Establish clear accountability, operating processes, and performance standards.
Remain hands-on and personally step in to solve complex financial and operational issues.

What We're Looking For

CPA designation (Canadian CPA, or a US CPA eligible for recognition in Ontario).
5+ years of relevant finance experience, with strong fundamentals and demonstrated ability to take ownership.
High ownership and accountability: takes full responsibility for outcomes, follows through, and solves problems without waiting to be told.
Digitally savvy and automation-driven: proficient with modern financial systems, AI tools, and automation; constantly looks for ways to eliminate manual work and improve efficiency.
Entrepreneurial and hands-on: willing to dive into details, solve problems, and get things done.
Strong foundation in accounting, P&L management, treasury, and financial operations.
Experience building or leading finance teams.

Who Thrives at Snaplii

Owns outcomes: Takes responsibility and follows through, especially when things go wrong.
Builds, not just manages: Creates systems, processes, partnerships, and teams from the ground up.
Thinks digital-first: Uses technology, AI, and automation to make finance smarter, faster, and more scalable.
Gets things done: Combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
Grows with the company: Is ambitious, adaptable, and excited to take on bigger responsibilities as Snaplii scales.

Compensation and Location

The role offers an annual compensation package of up to CAD $300,000, including base salary and a performance-based bonus, depending on experience.
Based in our Toronto office. Reports to the CEO. Our team works in both English and Mandarin.
